notes.title: New Game Released: Time Turned
notes.content:
Hey there!

If you enjoyed playing Squared Up, we think you'll enjoy what one of the developers of Squared Up has been working lately. Using the powers of a mysterious stopwatch, you can freeze time, rewind it, and create remnants of past version of yourself in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2877110/Time_Turned/][b]Time Turned[/b][/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2877110/Time_Turned

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41247118/f213494521417f0a6fd3cd06669764605c59d09f.png[/img]
You are the newest recruit to a world-famous organization of secret agents. With the time-bending stopwatch provided to you, you must work alongside past versions of yourself to solve puzzles and advance deeper into the secret lair of the evil Dr. Ineptus. Will you be able to foil his latest scheme before he sees his nefarious plot to completion?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41247118/7610063159c08d99c454aff017f9297fc867dbc6.png[/img]
The Organization's mystical stopwatch can freeze time, rewind it, and even create time clones. These temporal companions are perfect copies of the player that will replicate whatever the player has done taken since the beginning of each level. Cleverly utilizing these clones is essential to solving many of the challenges Time Turned presents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41247118/3522f51f4e1056e37156394fee12f1b3b36d3d29.png[/img]
